text:
Priya: FYI the onboarding sample app (js-sdk v0.9.1) started returning spikes of soft 429s when prefetch + cursor pagination + client-side pacing are on. Repro locally with sim load. Anyone see parity issue in go/sdk?
Alex: Huh, interesting. Is this with default windowing? What's your client config?
Priya: config snippet:
```
prefetch: true
page_size: 10
client_window: 60
max_inflight: 6
retry_policy: exponential, max_retries:2
```
Soft 429s only after warmup, not immediately.
Ming: Could be KV cache invalidation + prefetch race. Are you using token refresh on background thread? That can drop inflight requests briefly.
Priya: Yes, we kick token refresh when 401, but not proactively. No obvious 401s.
Sam: Do you have logs? Any 'queue full' or 'backpressure' metrics from SDK?
Priya: Captured short log snippet:
```
WARN backpressure: inflight=7 max=6 enqueue_failed
WARN http: 429 body="soft quota"
```
We see enqueue_failed right before 429.
Alex: Sounds like client-side enqueue fails then a flurry of retries hitting server soft limits. SDK should apply window backoff before retry. Might be parity bug where go sdk paces slower so JS overloads.
devex-bot: New issue created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4122 (assigning to eng-runtime and devex)
Ming: Quick repro I ran: toggling max_inflight down to 4 removes 429s. So short term fix for onboarding sample app is reducing concurrency.
Priya: OK. Could we add a sampleapp config with recommended defaults for prefetch+cursor to avoid this in tutorials?
Sam: Yep, also should document token refresh interactions + client throttler. I'll PR sample app docs.
Alex: I'll add a guard so enqueue_failed yields exponential jitter and a hint to throttle before retries. Will open PR against js-sdk.
Priya: Thanks. Assign me to the docs PR. Also, capture perf dashboard with per-route 429 spike so product can see.
devex-bot: linked INF-4122 to docs epic INF-4100
Priya: Marking this resolved in sample app by lowering default concurrency and adding note. Will follow up with the patch and release note.
